away_fan_de.headline: Stonebridge Golds zeigen Kampfgeist trotz Niederlage
away_fan_de.body: Die Stonebridge Golds mussten sich den Riverside Reds mit 1:4 geschlagen geben, doch Tomás Eastwick sorgte in der 89. Minute für den verdienten Ehrentreffer. Trotz der Niederlage zeigte unser Team großen Einsatz, insbesondere mit 389 angewandten Pressings, was die Reds unter Druck setzte. Leider konnten wir die vielen Chancen der Reds, die eine hohe xG von 2,76 hatten, nicht verhindern. Unsere Passgenauigkeit lag bei 60 %, was noch Raum für Verbesserungen lässt. Insgesamt war es ein harter Kampf, und wir nehmen viel Motivation für die kommenden Spiele mit.

answers.headline: How does pressure on the passer change the threat a pass adds in each third of the pitch?
answers.body: The threat added by a pass (xt_added_per_pass) varies with pressure and pitch third. In the attacking third, passes with no pressure add about 0.0009 threat (n=2743), while some pressure reduces this to -0.0062 (n=1289) and high pressure further reduces it to -0.0095 (n=6361). In the middle third, no pressure passes add nearly no threat (0.0001, n=9486), but some pressure drops it to -0.0014 (n=2951) and high pressure to -0.0029 (n=13767). In the defensive third, no pressure passes add 0.0001 threat (n=16233), some pressure slightly reduces it to -0.0002 (n=1089), and high pressure reduces it to -0.0009 (n=7390). Confidence intervals do not overlap between pressure bands, indicating real differences.

answers.headline: Which team loses the most threat per match through turnovers under high pressure?
answers.body: The Riverside Reds lose the most threat per match through turnovers under high pressure, with 1.19 threat lost per match over 14 matches. answers.headline: Against which team's press do opponents make the biggest decision gap under high pressure?
answers.body: Opponents make the biggest decision gap under high pressure against teams RIV and HAR, both with a mean decision gap of 0.0038 (n=4224 and 4062 passes respectively, 14 matches each). The confidence intervals for these two teams overlap (RIV: 0.0037-0.0040, HAR: 0.0036-0.0039), so the difference may be noise. Other teams have slightly lower decision gaps, with KIN having the smallest at 0.0032 (n=3045).

answers.headline: Is Riverside Reds' pass completion percentage under high pressure higher than the league's?
answers.body: Riverside Reds have a pass completion percentage under high pressure of 72.9% (n=3364 passes, 14 matches), which is higher than the league average of 69.9% (n=27518 passes, 56 matches). The confidence intervals do not overlap, suggesting this difference is likely meaningful and not just noise.
